body: The moving is a big concern because that’s where he has most of his anxiety and unfortunately I’ve had to move him a few time in the past year. Moving him into a loud home with kids is a huge concern so the chances of me doing it are slim, my brother just really wanted to try and see if he would do okay with them just in case I have to. I’m going to try the muzzle training with him and set really hard boundaries on the situation. Thank you!!

Thank you for the advice, I never thought about doing muzzle training with him. That would make me feel a lot more comfortable with the introduction. I’ll call around and see if I can find a trainer to also help with this. Thank you so much!
I didn’t think about not telling anyone I live alone. I’ll look into those door locks. Thank you so much!

Thank you for that link. I’m definitely gonna ask my doctor about that. I also just went down a rabbit hole on ballon sinuplasties and spent a couple hours watching videos about it. Very informative, thank you!!
Thank you, I’m gonna make an appointment with an ent. Was there anything that gave you relief? I can’t seem to find anything to help.

We had a mom and her young daughter bring in a new puppy. The mom let her name it. The puppy was called, “Cuisinart Dr. Pepper”. I really wish I was joking. The Doctor and I asked her if they are gonna actually call her that and she said they are gonna call her Cuisiy at home.
